definitions.explanation: the combination of different musical notes sung or played together; the pleasing arrangement of parts in music
a state of agreement, cooperation, or pleasing combination of elements

notes:
MUSIC TERM:
ハーモニー is used extensively in music to describe the combination of different notes or voices. It's also used metaphorically for any pleasing combination.

MUSIC COLLOCATIONS:
- ハーモニー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ - to match harmonies
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧ハーモニー - beautiful harmony
- ハーモニー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧ - harmony breaks down
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧/⟦{四|よん}→四：00767_yon⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ハーモニー - three-part/four-part harmony

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{和音|わおん}→和音：04751_waon⟧ - chord (technical music term)
- ⟦{調和|ちょうわ}→調和：05216_chouwa⟧ - harmony, balance (general/formal)
- ⟦メロディー→メロディー：05877_merodii⟧ - melody
- ⟦コーラス→コーラス：06574_koorasu⟧ - chorus

USAGE:
⟦{調和|ちょうわ}→調和：05216_chouwa⟧ is the native Japanese word for harmony (balance/coordination), while ハーモニー is specifically used in musical contexts or for aesthetic combinations.
